name: Leading in AI
tagline: Conversations with the people leading in the age of AI.
description: Executives, founders and thought-leaders discuss their work, share their perspectives, and explore where AI is going. A weekly interview podcast, in English, with a strongly European guest base.

newsletter.headline: New episodes, straight to your inbox.
newsletter.subheadline: One email per episode. Who the guest is, what they said, and the moments worth your time. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.
newsletter.successMessage: You're in. Check your inbox to confirm.

about.intro: Leading in AI is a weekly interview podcast featuring conversations with professionals, founders and academics who are building, deploying and thinking critically about AI in their organisations.
about.audience: It is made for executives, operators and builders who need a grounded view of AI from people doing the work, not a hype cycle. Every episode is a long-form conversation about what actually happened: the decisions, the trade-offs and what they would do differently.
about.format: Episodes are recorded in English and run around an hour. Most guests are based in Europe, with a strong Barcelona and wider Spanish community, and the show is published wherever you listen, starting with YouTube and Spotify.
